card.title: The Plan Gets Better
card.instruction: Celebrate every setback as proof that the scheme is becoming more sophisticated, selective, or impossible to detect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The alley's blocked. Excellent: our secret proposal picnic just got harder to discover.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm carrying your table. We have to use the main road.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better camouflage. Everyone will assume we're moving house.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your girlfriend's coming down the road.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Now she can carry the chairs without suspecting romance. The disguise gets more convincing.

mechanism: A celebrates obstructions to a secret proposal picnic as increasingly convincing camouflage.
confusable: Unlike claiming a failure was always planned, A must hail each setback as an improvement to the scheme now.
comparison: Public transport of furniture becomes cover involving the intended recipient, unlike the supper club narrowing its guests into a supplier meeting.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
